description: Operating defaults for Connect AI. These are POLICY DEFAULTS, not hard-coded absolutes. Registries may override per service/department so future needs don't get blocked.

host.reason: localhost resolves to IPv6 (::1) on Windows and mismatches Docker port-forwarding -> timeouts. Default to 127.0.0.1, but a service may declare an override in tool-registry/port-registry when genuinely needed.

localModel.reason: 8GB VRAM (RTX 5070 Laptop). Models >8b (14b~9GB, 20b~13GB) spill to CPU and can starve other agents/MCP of GPU. Allow larger models only with explicit user approval, ideally when other agents are idle.

notes: Designed by Claude (brain). Keeps 127.0.0.1 / 8b as safe defaults while leaving an explicit, auditable override path. Codex wires the loader to read defaults here and apply registry overrides.
